shared_elements: schematic human/anthropomorphic figure with raised arms
registers or horizontal bands dividing the surface
row of repeated vertical elements forming a band
justification: Both surfaces organise schematic profile animals and small anthropomorphic figures into stacked horizontal registers, and both include a band of repeated vertical strokes, but these are generic organising devices rather than shared motifs. A's content is dominated by large predatory quadrupeds, big-beaked birds and a boar in high-relief with modelled bodies, while B is filled with linear outline boats with crew-strokes, ships and grid/ladder patterns — no distinctive motif is shared.
